quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #21
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 15

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks only.
Trucks are entering the highway.
There is a steep hill ahead.
Trucks have the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a steep hill is coming. Be ready to change your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: When you drive past a car that just parked on the side of the road, what should you do?

options.text: Expect the driver to open the door as you pass.
Speed up.
Slam on your brakes.
Expect the driver to wait for you to pass before opening the door.

questions.correctAnswerText: Expect the driver to open the door as you pass.
questions.explanation: When passing a parked car, be ready for the driver to open the door. Drive with extra caution near parked vehicles.

questions.question: Your vehicle's wheels have gone off the edge of the road. What should you do first?

options.text: Turn the front wheels slightly left to get back on the road.
Hold the steering wheel firmly, let off the gas, and gently apply the brakes.
Brake hard and turn the front wheels sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold the steering wheel firmly, let off the gas, and gently apply the brakes.
questions.explanation: If your vehicle goes off the road, hold the steering wheel firmly, release the gas pedal, and gently apply the brakes. Slow down. Then check traffic and find a safe place to return to the road. Do not jerk the wheel sharply. This can cause you to lose control or swerve into other lanes.

questions.question: A driver license is a:

options.text: Right, not a privilege.
Privilege, not a right.
Legal requirement.

questions.correctAnswerText: Privilege, not a right.
questions.explanation: A driver license is a privilege. You must earn it and keep it in good standing.

questions.question: When driving to a place you don't know, you should:

options.text: Rely on road signs to find your way.
Plan your trip before you leave.
Only know roughly where your destination is.
Always take the most direct route.

questions.correctAnswerText: Plan your trip before you leave.
questions.explanation: Plan your trip before you start driving. Know exactly where you are going. Check a map of your destination before you leave home.

questions.question: Traffic signals show arrows to control turns from certain lanes. A solid yellow arrow means:

options.text: It is never used as a traffic signal.
It means the same as a yellow traffic light.
You can turn in the direction the arrow shows.
A green arrow is coming next.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same as a yellow traffic light.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow arrow means the same as a yellow traffic light. Slow down and prepare to stop at a red light.

questions.question: Alcohol is:

options.text: A stimulant.
An antihistamine.
A depressant.

questions.correctAnswerText: A depressant.
questions.explanation: Alcohol is a depressant. It slows your thinking and makes your reflexes slower and unreliable.

questions.question: An oncoming driver does not dim their high beam headlights. Where should you look?

options.text: At the wheels of the oncoming vehicle.
Toward the right edge of the road.
Toward the left edge of the road.
Straight ahead down the middle of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Toward the right edge of the road.
questions.explanation: If an oncoming driver does not dim their lights, look toward the right side of the road. This keeps you from being blinded and helps you stay on the road until the other vehicle passes.

questions.question: When passing another vehicle, you should move back into the right lane when:

options.text: You are one car length ahead of the vehicle you passed.
You can see both headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.
You are 50 feet ahead of the passed vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can see both headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: Only pass if you have enough space to return safely to the right lane. Make sure there is enough room between you and the vehicle you passed. When you can see both headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror, it is safe to move back.

questions.question: When driving, look ____ ahead of your vehicle.

options.text: One minute
45 seconds
15 to 20 seconds
10 seconds

questions.correctAnswerText: 15 to 20 seconds
questions.explanation: Look 15 to 20 seconds ahead for cars that are stopping, turning, or entering or exiting the road. This helps you avoid sudden stops and sharp turns.

questions.question: If a traffic light shows both red and a green arrow, can a driver turn in the direction of the arrow?

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: False
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can turn in that direction after you yield to other traffic. You can turn even if other lights are red.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow centerline mean?

options.text: Passing is not allowed.
You can pass on the right when it is safe.
You can pass on the left when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can pass on the left when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line on your side means you can cross it to pass other cars if the road ahead is clear.

questions.question: What is the illegal blood alcohol level for drivers age 21 or older?

options.text: 0.05 percent
0.08 percent
0.02 percent
0.1 percent

questions.correctAnswerText: 0.08 percent
questions.explanation: Drivers age 21 or older cannot drive with a blood alcohol level of 0.08 percent or higher. Drunk driving is illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for pedestrians crossing.
No passing zone.
Work zone ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This orange sign warns you that roadwork is coming. Stay alert for temporary traffic signs in work zones.

questions.question: You are waiting in the intersection to turn left. What should you do?

options.text: Signal and turn your wheels to the left.
Signal and keep your wheels straight.
Flash your headlights to get other drivers to let you through.
Drive around a car that blocks you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal and keep your wheels straight.
questions.explanation: Always signal before turning. Keep your wheels straight while waiting to turn left. If you are hit from behind, this keeps you from being pushed into oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What should drivers do when driving in bad weather?

options.text: Drive faster to get to your destination sooner.
Stay closer to the car in front of you.
Stay farther away from the car in front of you.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay farther away from the car in front of you.
questions.explanation: In wet weather, increase the distance between your car and the car ahead. This gives you more time to stop.

questions.question: A child is about to run into the street. What should you do?

options.text: Get ready to slow down.
Flash your headlights.
Honk your horn loudly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Honk your horn loudly.
questions.explanation: Use a loud horn blast when a child or pedestrian is about to step into the street in front of your car. This may alert them to the danger.

questions.question: There are cars coming toward you on the left and parked cars on the right. Where should you steer?

options.text: Closer to the oncoming cars than the parked cars.
Closer to the parked cars than the oncoming cars.
In the middle between the oncoming and parked cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the middle between the oncoming and parked cars.
questions.explanation: Steer a middle course between the oncoming cars and parked cars. This gives you the most room to avoid hitting either side.

questions.question: A solid yellow line is next to the broken yellow line on your side. When can you pass?

options.text: Only in emergencies.
Only on expressways.
When the road ahead is clear.
Only at intersections.

questions.correctAnswerText: When the road ahead is clear.
questions.explanation: When you have a broken yellow line on your side, you can pass if there is no oncoming traffic and the road ahead is clear.

questions.question: Another car is passing you in a no passing zone. What should you do?

options.text: Pull off the road.
Keep your speed and position the same.
Slow down so the other car can safely get back in the lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down so the other car can safely get back in the lane.
questions.explanation: Slow down to help the passing car return to the lane safely. This helps everyone avoid hazards ahead.
